title: Omnipod Dash - option to mute alerts regarding pod needs to be changed during grace period
body:
After using a pod for 72 hours the omnipod dash beeps several times during the 8 hour grace period to alert you to replace it. There is no option to disable this alert in AAPS today. This ticket is regarding adding that option. 

I have discussed it on discord and it seem possible to add this option. Since there are alerts in Nightscout / AAPS  / AAPSclient for pod needing to be changed I find this alarm quite unnecessary and disturbing as it alerts several times. 

Example today it was embarrassing for my son as it happend during class and other places when these alerts make lot of attention. 

Thank you all for your hard work.

comments.body: This definitely would be a handy setting to have.

I wonder if this even possible? Are the alarms not built into the pod hardware?

Personally, I just use a paperclip to break the buzzer, and apply a little BluTac to retain waterproofness, prior to applying each pod.

Yes it is possible, Ive hardcoded this in my own branch to be disabled. I can make a proper solution with a setting for this.

@MilosKozak Given that original PDM does not support this is this wanted?
If this functionality is desired, what has the preference:
1. A single setting that just disables all pod expiration sounds
2. A setting that allows the users from when they want to have the expiration alarm? E.g. at hour 72 (default) or hour 79 etc. setting that at 80 hours will disable the expiration sounds

Edit: Option2 will possible require 2 settings to be consistent with current settings menu

Note in all cases the scream at 80 hours will still happen
If i get a vote option 2 is for me perfect! 👍😎👏
